page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc7.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. It features 2 physical cores and 2 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, with no hyperthreading enabled. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of RAM, yielding 2.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or a GPU, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks indicate a divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the average range. However, multi-core and memory-bound operations perform poorly. The stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core score, and Passmark CPU score are rated in the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with large-block read and write speeds of 15.84 GB/sec and 13.29 GB/sec respectively, both categorized as poor.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance offers a predictable compute environment but is constrained by its low memory capacity and lack of local storage. From a cost-efficiency perspective, it provides a low-entry-point dedicated compute resource, though its resource density limits its utility for memory-intensive or highly parallelized tasks. Appropriate workloads are restricted to lightweight, single-threaded applications, basic web serving, simple text processing, and minor utility tasks that do not require high memory bandwidth or local disk I/O.
